B1656's coupling is Y = u h^T + h u^T - (u.h) 1 + u1 [h]_x + h0 (u1 1 + [u]_x) exactly; its channel 1 is E8's eps and its channels i, j, k are a triplet; under T and S the channel weights (u1, u) transform as 1 + rho', u by the same cube rotation as the Higgs, so Y(g tau) = scalar R Y(tau) R^T (B1724's covariance from structure).
